description_en: Queries addresses in an address book by paging
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-addresses --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAddresses

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the address book to query
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The address to query. You can set this parameter to perform a fuzzy match on added addresses
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的地址。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已添加的地址
parameters.name: address_like

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned in the previous API call. Leave this parameter empty for the first page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值。首页查询无需传入
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-500，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

GmtModified.description_en: The most recent modification time of the address. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
GmtModified.description_zh: 地址的最近修改时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分页查询时每页个数。取值范围为：1-500，默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token for the next page. If a next page exists, this field contains a value.
If this parameter has a return value, a next page exists. You can pass the returned NextToken as a request parameter to retrieve the next page of data. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页查询凭证（Token），如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。
该参数只要返回值，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到无返回值，表示获取到了所有的数据

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
